ops.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
rm -rf /usr/share/sddm/themes/MySddm
install -d /usr/share/sddm/themes/MySddm
cp -rT /tmp/sb/home/.config/rexon/extensions/login2/data/MySddm /usr/share/sddm/themes/MySddm
chmod -R a+rX /usr/share/sddm/themes/MySddm
echo "SDDM theme installed: "MySddm

#!/bin/bash
set -e
install -d /usr/share/backgrounds
rm -f /usr/share/backgrounds/rexon-login.* 2>/dev/null || true
cp -f /tmp/sb/home/.config/rexon/extensions/login4/data/deep/huge_photo.png /usr/share/backgrounds/rexon-login.png
chmod 644 /usr/share/backgrounds/rexon-login.png
install -d /etc/dconf/db/gdm.d
cat > /etc/dconf/db/gdm.d/02-rexon-login <<REXON_EOF
[org/gnome/desktop/background]
picture-uri='file:///usr/share/backgrounds/rexon-login.png'
picture-uri-dark='file:///usr/share/backgrounds/rexon-login.png'
picture-options='zoom'
REXON_EOF
dconf update 2>/dev/null || true
